title: MacOsy Hub | Auto train, farm, buy, equip, speed .....
features:
Auto Train: Automatically trains to boost character stats.



Select Stage: Selects the target stage to run.



Auto Farm Stage: Automatically battles and farms the selected stage.



Auto Rebirth: Automatically performs rebirth/prestige when requirements are met.



Auto Open Chest: Automatically opens chests to collect gear and items.



Auto Equip Best Gear: Automatically equips the strongest gear from the inventory.



Auto Buy Hall Weapons: Automatically purchases weapons available in the Hall.



Auto Upgrade Attribute: Automatically assigns and upgrades attribute points.



Auto AFK Zone: Automatically moves the character to the AFK reward zone.



Attribute Priority: Sets the priority order for stat upgrades (Attack, Defense, Health, or Smart).
